messages.text:
"Create a beautiful, realistic 3D open-world roleplay game.

GAME WORLD:
- A huge modern city with skyscrapers.
- Beautiful neighborhoods and luxury mansions.
- Schools, hospitals, supermarkets and restaurants.
- Parks, beaches and shopping malls.
- Realistic roads, traffic lights and sidewalks.
- A complete day and night cycle.
- Dynamic weather, including rain and sunshine.

PLAYER:
- Create your own character.
- Customize face, hair, clothes and accessories.
- Third-person camera.
- Smooth walking, running and jumping animations.
- Realistic character movements.

VEHICLES:
- Drive cars, motorcycles and bicycles.
- Enter and exit vehicles.
- Customize and paint cars.
- Realistic driving physics.

ROLEPLAY:
- Get a job and earn virtual money.
- Buy houses and apartments.
- Meet other players or interact with NPCs.
- Visit restaurants and shops.
- Go to school and complete activities.
- Own pets.
- Make friends and create your own story.

GRAPHICS:
- High-quality 3D graphics.
- Beautiful lighting and shadows.
- Realistic water and reflections.
- Detailed buildings and environments.

CONTROLS:
- Mobile touchscreen joystick.
- Jump, run and interact buttons.
- Easy vehicle controls.
- Optimized for tablets.

IMPORTANT:
Make this a fully playable 3D game, not a 2D game.
Create a large explorable world with lots of activities and freedom.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
